text: P1: checkout is returning 504s. This is a customer-facing bug, ticket CHECKOUT-504. Confirm-page requests die before the payment callback. Nobody has fixed it yet — checkout is still down.
Ack CHECKOUT-504, pulling logs now. Paging @sarah on the payments path.
CHECKOUT-504 root cause: fraud checks run synchronously on the confirm path and exhaust the request deadline. Moving them onto an async queue worker so the HTTP handler returns immediately.
I'm blocking the release, rolling back to sync checks. Not comfortable shipping the queue worker without a longer soak.
Override: we are not rolling back. Async worker p95 is 40ms against 900ms sync — benchmarks in the thread. We ship the queue path, not the rollback.
